reviews.title: Good aio for start of a price
reviews.comment: I'm fairly satisfied with this cooler even the price is good my first 360mm radiator choice that can handle extra cooling better than ones I compare with 240mm radiator by 3 degree cools than the old 240mm left long on idle, works  normally right after installing it from now on this will last me longer I could be more happy.
reviews.author: andrew

reviews.title: Incredible value
reviews.comment: came with the fans pre-assembled which I really appreciated for saving me the time.  Its a great value for the money, and certainly looks and feels the part of a more expensive AIO.  Its very effective in cooling my power hungry 9900X and it looks great too.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: Easily worth the purchase
reviews.comment: Very easy set up process. Wires already connected. Keeps temps low. Fans aren’t loud. Mine has been pretty sturdy so far. The white just fits my case but I’m sure the black looks just as good.
reviews.author: Ty

reviews.title: Well worth the money!
reviews.comment: So far it’s being working great! Easy to mount, LEDs are fully customizable, and sync up with my ram and other fans. Keeps my cpu and case nice and cool, I can play Star Wars Outlaws at 1080p for hours and maybe break 45c
